sicherung.extern.ohne: No off-site copy set up yet. If Ablago runs on a NAS with a backup app, the app copies the backup folder. Without one (Raspberry Pi, rented server) a package such as “Backup destination WebDAV” takes every backup to Nextcloud, a NAS or the hosting provider and checks it there.
sicherung.extern.erklaerung: Every backup is first created here in the backup folder; then the package copies it in the background and checks it at the destination. The local backup stays – it is the fast restore; the off-site copy is the protection against fire, theft or disk failure. The key is never at the destination.
sicherung.extern.hinweis.fehler: The off-site copy of the backup of {datum} failed.
sicherung.extern.hinweis.alt: The last off-site copy is older than 2 days.
sicherung.extern.hinweis.letzte: The backup of {datum} was the last to arrive there.
sicherung.extern.hinweis.nie: No backup has arrived there yet.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.kann-nicht: The destination’s package can’t fetch backups back – get the file and its .json from the destination yourself.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.nicht-erreichba: The destination can’t be reached right now.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.nicht-am-ziel: The destination no longer lists this backup.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.ohne-pruefsumme: The metadata (.json) with the checksum is missing at the destination.
sicherung.entfernt.grund.abweichend: Size or checksum at the destination differ.
sicherung.extern.schlank: Off-site copy of {datum} – Ablago reads version and scope from the backup with the key
sicherung.extern.nurneueste.hilfe: For tight space when an off-site copy is made: older automatic backups then only exist there. A backup that is being copied off-site stays until it has arrived (at most 2 days).
sicherung.extern.nurneueste.gesperrt: Only possible once an off-site backup is set up and its last copy succeeded.
sicherung.extern.nurneueste.wirkt: The off-site destination keeps older backups. Only the newest one stays here – the retention below does not apply then.
sicherung.extern.nurneueste.wirkt-nicht: There is currently no successful off-site copy (destination removed, switched off, failed or behind). Until one arrives again, Ablago keeps older backups here according to the retention below.
sicherung.extern.nurneueste.hinweis: “Keep only the newest locally” is currently not in effect.
daten.einleitung: Lasting settings for the bin and exports. They apply to the whole library until you change them again – not just to one export or one deletion.
daten.export.schalter: Users may export their own data
daten.export.hinweis: Under My account → Account → Export my data: folders they may read, their tasks and reminders – in the format of the full export (right to data portability, GDPR Art. 20). Off by default.
daten.export.an: Users may export their own data.
daten.export.aus: Export my data is switched off.
vollexport.einstellung: Whether users may export their own data is set under {link}.
export.ohne-ordner: Without an export folder there is no export.
export.ablage: Exports lie unencrypted in the export folder, not with the backups. Ablago deletes every export after downloading, at the latest after {tage} days.
export.container: The export folder is inside the container. That’s enough for downloading as a ZIP. If you want to copy large exports directly from the folder, give it its own volume in the Compose file.
export.im-sicherungsordner: The export folder is inside the backup folder.
export.im-sicherungsordner.text: Exports are unencrypted and would therefore go along with every copy of the backup, for example into the cloud. In the Compose file, put the volume for /data/export somewhere outside the backup folder.
export.umzug_one: One export was still in the backup folder and is now in the export folder.
export.umzug_other: {anzahl} exports were still in the backup folder and are now in the export folder.
export.umzug.text: Exports are unencrypted and don’t belong in the backup copy. They are now under {pfad} and are deleted after downloading or after {tage} days.
export.umzug.uebrig: Some things couldn’t be moved and are still in the subfolder export/ of the backup folder. Delete them there or exclude them from the backup copy.
sicherung.notfallblatt.benutzt: The emergency code on the emergency sheet has been used.
sicherung.notfallblatt.benutzt.text: It works only once. Download a new emergency sheet with a new code, print it and destroy the old one.
sicherung.notfallblatt.ohne-code: Your emergency sheet still lacks the emergency code.
sicherung.notfallblatt.ohne-code.text: With it you get back in if you have locked yourself out. Download the emergency sheet again and print it.
sicherung.lege-eine-an-und: {b} Create one and switch on the schedule.
sicherung.die-letzte-sicherung-ist-2: The last backup is older than 2 days
sicherung.das-notfallblatt-gehoert-zu: The emergency sheet belongs to an earlier key.
sicherung.ohne-den-schluessel-darauf: {b} Without the key on it the backups can’t be restored.
sicherung.die-letzte-probe-wiederherstel: The last test restore is from {zeit}.
sicherung.noch-keine-sicherung-wurde: No backup has been test-restored yet.
sicherung.erst-eine-probe-zeigt: {b} Only a test shows that a backup can be restored in an emergency.
sicherung.der-sicherungsordner-ist-kein: The backup folder isn’t a volume of its own.
sicherung.die-sicherungen-liegen-im: {b} The backups are inside the container and will be gone after the next update.
sicherung.die-sicherungen-liegen-auf: The backups are on the same disk as the documents.
sicherung.faellt-sie-aus-sind: {b} If it fails, both are gone – copy the backup folder to another disk or off site.
sicherung.eine-sicherung-enthaelt-die: A backup contains the whole database and all files at the same moment – encrypted with the key from {link}. Next to it is a readable file (.json) with version, scope and checksum.
sicherung.seit-du-kannst-die: {bytes}{wert} · since {zeit}. You can leave the page; Ablago stays usable.
sicherung.ablago-laeuft-dabei-weiter: Ablago keeps running meanwhile. Nobody has to be signed out for a backup.
sicherung.sicherungen-sind-mit-einem_one: One backup is encrypted with an earlier key.
sicherung.sicherungen-sind-mit-einem_oth: {anzahl} backups are encrypted with an earlier key.
sicherung.zum-wiederherstellen-brauchst-: {b} To restore them you need the emergency sheet for that key – keep it as long as such backups exist.
sicherung.alle-sicherungen-mit-frueherem: Delete the backup with the earlier key?
Delete all {anzahl} backups with an earlier key?
sicherung.sie-sind-danach-endgueltig: They’re gone for good afterwards; you won’t need the old emergency sheet any more.
sicherung.sicherungen-mit-frueherem-schl: Backups with an earlier key deleted.
Delete backups with an earlier key
sicherung.noch-keine-sicherung-im: No backup in the folder {span} yet.
sicherung.schluessel-braucht-das-notfall: Key {fingerabdruck} – needs the emergency sheet for this key
sicherung.laden.notfallblatt: To restore, you need your emergency sheet (key).
sicherung.laden.text: Your browser is now downloading the backup from {zeit} – encrypted, exactly as it is in the backup folder. You will find progress and cancel in the browser’s downloads.
sicherung.laden.metadaten: Keep the metadata next to it ({link}): without it, the backup cannot be restored on a new device. It contains no key.
sicherung.laden.handbuch: How to check the copy on your computer ↗
sicherung.liste.aufbewahrung: Ablago clears away older automatic backups by itself: it keeps the newest {taeglich} daily, {woechentlich} weekly and {monatlich} monthly ones. Backups made by hand stay until you delete them.
sicherung.liste.aufbewahrung.neueste: Ablago clears away older automatic backups by itself: it keeps only the newest one. Backups made by hand stay until you delete them.
sicherung.liste.frage.text: This frees about {platz}. They will be gone for good.
sicherung.liste.frage.alle: That is all of them: afterwards there is no local backup left.
sicherung.liste.fehlschlaege_one: One backup could not be deleted. It stays selected:
sicherung.liste.fehlschlaege_other: {anzahl} backups could not be deleted. They stay selected:
sicherung.pruefen-rechnet-die-pruefsumme: “Check” recalculates the file’s checksum and compares it with the one in the metadata: that shows whether the file is unchanged since it was created.
sicherung.jede-ist-vollstaendig-die: (each is complete; the database is compressed, documents hardly)
sicherung.weniger-frei-als-verringere: {b} Less free than {wert}. Reduce the retention or make room.
sicherung.faustregel-3-2-1: Rule of thumb 3-2-1: three copies, on two different media, one of them off site. Let the NAS copy the backup folder on, e.g. to a USB disk or to the cloud.
sicherung.erst-wenn-verschluesselung-fer: Only possible once encryption is fully set up – this is done by whoever manages encryption.
sicherung.keine-berechtigung-verschluess: You do not have permission to manage encryption.
sicherung.aufbewahrt-werden-die-neuesten: The newest automatic backups are kept: the last one of each day, week and month. Ones created by hand stay until you delete them.
sicherung.der-schluessel-hat-sich: The key has changed since then.
sicherung.lade-ein-neues-notfallblatt: {b} Download a new emergency sheet. Keep the old one as long as you have older backups – they need the old key.
sicherung.erst-moeglich-wenn-es: Only possible once there is a key.
sicherung.spielt-die-neueste-sicherung: Restores the newest backup into a separate, temporary area of the database and checks it: checksum, decryption, check word, number of folders, documents and users, check values of up to 20 files. The running Ablago stays untouched; the area is removed afterwards.
sicherung.probe-ergebnis-nicht-gespeiche: The test restore completed, but its result could not be saved: {fehler}
vollexport.name: Name
vollexport.deine-daten-gehoeren-dir: Your data belongs to you: the full export writes {b} – folders, original documents with all versions, notes, tasks, history, structure – in open formats (CSV, JSON, Excel, PDF, iCalendar, vCard) into a folder you can read without Ablago. Unlike the backup it is {b2} – keep it safe.
vollexport.zu-wenig-platz-am: Not enough space at the target.
vollexport.das-protokoll-seit-dem: the log since the last start
vollexport.im-format-von-bitwarden: in Bitwarden’s format, for importing into a password manager
vollexport.passwortfelder-im-klartext-al: Password fields in plain text as passwoerter.csv{klein}
vollexport.mir-ist-klar-die: I understand: the passwords are unencrypted in the file. This is logged.
vollexport.diese-mappentypen-sehen-nach: These folder types look like contacts. Check how the fields are mapped; deselected folder types get no vCard.
vollexport.nach-dem-import-in: {b} – delete after importing into the password manager.
vollexport.zip.hinweis: Download the checksums first, then the ZIP. After downloading, the export is deleted on the server; the ZIP's checksum and the checksum file stay here for a few more days.
vollexport.zip.heruntergeladen: Downloaded on {am} and deleted on the server · entry until {bis}
vollexport.zip.erklaerung: Use it to check that the downloaded ZIP is complete and unchanged. After unpacking, the file SHA256SUMS checks every file in it – LIESMICH.md explains how.
vollexport.zip.kopieren-fehler: Copying doesn't work here – select the checksum and copy it yourself.
vollexport.zip.entfernen-text: The ZIP's checksum and the checksum file will then be gone. The ZIP you downloaded stays with you.
wiederherstellung.ersetzt-den-jetzigen-s: Replaces the current state with a backup. Beforehand Ablago backs up the current state itself. It restores into a separate area first and only switches over when everything has worked – if something fails, everything stays as it is. Afterwards Ablago restarts and everyone signs in again.
wiederherstellung.wiederherstellen-geht-: Restoring only works in active maintenance mode
wiederherstellung.damit-niemand-gleichze: {b}, so nobody works at the same time.
